description: Find Aave positions at risk of liquidation across 5 chains. Returns positions with health factor, risk score (0–100), risk level (critical/danger/warning), collateral, and debt amounts. Use when asked: 'Which positions are close to liquidation on Arbitrum?', 'Show me the riskiest Aave positions on Base', 'How many critical positions are there?'

chain.description: Liquidation risk chain: risk-ethereum, risk-arbitrum, risk-base, risk-polygon, risk-optimism

first.description: Number of positions to return (default 25), sorted by riskScore desc

riskLevel.description: Filter by risk level (omit to get all non-safe positions)

name: get_at_risk_positions
